backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister declaring an empty actor.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping theme‑related requirements to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of key frontend files including pages, hooks, components, and styling files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens for light and dark modes with global CSS variables.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures the TanStack Router and renders pages with a global theme bar and toaster.
frontend/src/components/DiamondIcon.tsx: Simple component rendering a styled ♦ icon using theme colors.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggleBar.t: Fixed bottom bar allowing cycling between four themes and three color schemes with a visual indicator.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and refreshes an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useColorScheme.ts: Manages blue/purple/green color scheme state persisted in localStorage and applied via a data attribute.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future backend query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages four app themes with localStorage persistence, migration from old values, and application via data attributes.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and multiple theme variables for light, dark, and orange modes.
frontend/src/lib/mgp.ts: Provides functions to validate MGP IDs and generate related error messages.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Renders checkout form and navigates to confirmation with a randomized arrival date.
frontend/src/pages/Gen4ElcOptions.tsx: Displays Gen 4 ELC model options with MGP ID validation for certain purchases.
frontend/src/pages/Gen5Options.tsx: Shows Gen 5 model options including preorder flow with MGP ID validation.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page linking to Gen 4 and Gen 5 option pages with styled cards.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmation.tsx: A React page displaying order confirmation details using search params for model and arrival date with UI components and a home navigation button.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, radii, shadows, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project state, listing theme-related features, their requirements, statuses, and metadata for the multi‑theme UI project.
